deviation: The liability cap is reduced to 0.5x annual fees, half the standard 1x and well below the 2x fallback. Because the cap is mutual, it also limits what Arcadia can recover for supplier breaches, which leaves Arcadia under-compensated for losses.
suggested_text: Each party's total aggregate liability arising under this Agreement shall not exceed 1 times the annual fees paid or payable. This cap shall not apply to liability for fraud, IP infringement indemnity, or breach of confidentiality, which shall be uncapped.
